Create ONE portrait high-fidelity iPhone app design concept, approx 887x1774, a single whole straight-on iPhone mockup with slim titanium dark bezel and even small outside margins. No outside captions or extra phones. This is a refinement of Minor AI, assistant-first. References: image 1 is the CURRENT APP HOME and determines the core composition, atmosphere and spaciousness. Image 2 is a prior proposed redesign and is ONLY a reference for subtle phone frame, SF Pro typography, controls and surface craft; do NOT use its dashboard, project list, tasks or huge header. Image 3 is the exact Minor AI logo asset: use this supplied mark as an inserted element, preserving its precise rounded heptagonal rings and core, aspect ratio and proportions, NEVER invent a new logo. Brand is Minor AI, no replacement brand.
Important product direction: retain magical transition from animated splash into a living AI assistant, not a projects dashboard. Calm matte #121212 screen, barely visible mint #BBFFDF residual light near bottom, #232323 composer surface, white main controls, restrained mint #2FFF9E indicator. Spacious native iOS screen, at least half the screen is purposeful open conversational space. No 3D orb, robot, neon, star particles, brains, circuit boards, glossy glass effects or decorative UI clutter. Thin quiet borders, comfortable native 44pt targets. Exact Russian text, readable clean SF Pro-like body ~17pt, heading maximum 24pt. No enormous marketing headline, no content cards except optional one small resume row specifically requested below. No global bottom 4-tab navigation. Centerpiece is the real Minor mark SMALL about 62pt wide, softly gray-white, centered horizontally at 45% of usable phone height (same anchor as current home, important for splash continuity). Under it gentle greeting 'О чём подумаем?' and one restrained secondary line 'Напишите или начните говорить.' Do not make logo a massive bright emblem.
